subject: Reconcile double-booked SE for FinEx demo — split vs. backup vs. recording
messages:
From: Timothy Salas <timothy.salas@finex.co>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Anna Berg <anna.berg@finex.co>
Date: 2028-08-30T14:12:00-04:00
Subject: FinEx product walkthrough — proposed next Thu 10:00am BST

Thanks Sofia — excited to see Redwood in action.

We have a handful of stakeholders here at FinEx who'd like a live walkthrough next week. Proposed time: Thursday 2028-09-07 10:00am BST (1:00am PDT).

Agenda: short intro (5m), product walkthrough (30m), integration Q&A (20m), next steps (5m).

Attendees: me (Tim), Anna (security), Martin Lopez (integration lead) — I can share a calendar invite.

Would that work for SE coverage from your side? We prefer the engineer to be present for the integration portion.

Attaching a quick agenda (FinEx_demo_agenda_v2.pdf) and will send invite shortly.

—Tim
Timothy Salas
Head of Integrations, FinEx
+44 20 7946 0xxx
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Cc: Anna Berg <anna.berg@finex.co>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-08-30T15:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: FinEx product walkthrough — proposed next Thu 10:00am BST

Thanks Tim — that slot works on our side. I’ve looped in Karthik (SE) to co-host the demo and cover integration questions.

Karthik / FYI — will you be able to join Thu 10:00am BST? I’ll send the calendar invite (calendar_invite.ics) and attach the agenda.

Options if there’s a conflict: we can bring Monica as backup (short handoff), split the session into two 30-min blocks (overview + deep integration), or record the walkthrough and do a focused live Q&A with the integration lead.

Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Timothy Salas <timothy.salas@finex.co>, Anna Berg <anna.berg@finex.co>
Date: 2028-08-31T08:20:00+01:00
Subject: Re: FinEx product walkthrough — proposed next Thu 10:00am BST

On Thu, 30 Aug 2028 at 15:03, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai wrote:
> Karthik / FYI — will you be able to join Thu 10:00am BST?

Heads up — I’m booked on customer on-call travel that day (onsite in Amsterdam) and my calendar shows an overlap from 09:30–11:00 BST that was just published by the customer. I can’t guarantee the full hour. Sorry for the short notice.

I can do a few choices:
- Option A: Monica joins as primary SE for the 10:00 slot (she’s fully briefed and can cover integration). I’ll join the last 15–20 mins remote for the integration deep-dive if my travel timing allows.
- Option B: Split into two 30-min sessions the same day — 10:00–10:30 (overview + demo) led by Sofia + Monica, then 11:00–11:30 deep integration with me (or remote recording then follow-up).
- Option C: Proceed with the one-hour slot, I’ll record a 15-min advanced integration walkthrough ahead of time and Monica will field live integration questions — we can play the recording during the meeting if needed.

If FinEx prefers a single point of contact, Monica is a safe swap.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Timothy Salas <timothy.salas@finex.co>, Anna Berg <anna.berg@finex.co>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-01T09:40:00+01:00
Subject: Re: FinEx product walkthrough — proposed next Thu 10:00am BST

Tim — thanks for flagging availability. Quick recap of options from our side and my recommendation:

1) Swap SE: Monica can cover the full hour (she’s prepped on FinEx requirements). Karthik will be on standby.
2) Split session: 30m overview (Sofia + Monica) + 30m integration deep-dive (Karthik remote, or recorded + Q&A).
3) Single hour + recording: We pre-record a 15-minute integration segment Karthik prepared, play that during the meeting and Monica handles live Q&A.

Given Martin’s presence, I suggest Option 2 (split) — it keeps the integration time focused and avoids delay if Karthik’s travel runs long. If you prefer a single session, Option 1 is the easiest for continuity.

If you confirm, I’ll update the invite and indicate who will present each block + attach the recording (if applicable).

Attachments: FinEx_demo_agenda_v2.pdf (updated with split markers), calendar_invite.ics

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
From: Timothy Salas <timothy.salas@finex.co>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Anna Berg <anna.berg@finex.co>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-01T16:45:00-04:00
Subject: Re: FinEx product walkthrough — proposed next Thu 10:00am BST

Thanks team — appreciate the options. We prefer the split approach (Option 2): overview at 10:00–10:30 (Sofia + Monica) and integration deep-dive 11:00–11:30 with Karthik remote. That works best for Martin’s schedule.

Please update the invite to show two blocks (I’ve invited Martin and Anna to both). If Karthik ends up delayed, we’ll watch the short recording and reconvene for follow-up.

Looking forward to it — will confirm final attendee list by EOD Monday.

—Tim
